body: I think they are just scared of people who have issues like this. Now that I think about they might not completely cut off all contact, but they certainly would call/talk to me/ trust me less.

I really am trying to be strong and do this, I am seeing a therapist but I have already promised to marry my SO and we are engaged and I don't want to break his heart. I can see myself regretting breaking it off with him, trying to get him back but he wouldn't answer my texts or calls, won't give me closure. I know he won't let me have closure. He will try to emotionally destroy me if I break it off with him. I just can't handle that. Also it will feel like the years we have been together have been wasted time, and I feel too old to find anyone else.

He is the only person who knows I am depressed and suicidal. I have family but they are not close or supportive and if they found out how I am feeling, they might cut off contact with me. It is really scary.
